correctness.rationale: For real large nu and x>0, published global inequalities bound both shifted Bessel-product functionals uniformly. The exact second-order differential identities, evaluated at genuine interior global maxima where f′=0 and f″<=0, force x^2/(x^2+nu^2+f) toward 2/5 and 3/5 respectively. This localizes every maximizing ray to sqrt(2/3) and sqrt(3/2), avoiding an unjustified global Debye approximation. The compact differentiated Debye series then gives strict local concavity, eventual uniqueness, leading values 1/5 and 7/20 and order-nu^-2 deficits 54/625 and 108/625, respectively, with optimizer shifts 17 sqrt(6)/150 and 27 sqrt(6)/80 times nu^-2. Independent SymPy differentiation and exact substitution reproduced all four coefficients and both negative second derivatives (-108/125, -144/125). The proof assumes the cited second-order identities and compact Debye expansion; no effective onset nu0.
